beats.headline: Two trap modules
beats.text: Back in the safe room after the show, Donut opens her loot boxes from the earlier battle. The only new things are two Trap Modules from her gold sapper's box, one called a Spike Module and the other an Alarm Module. They are ready-to-go traps, no tinkering required. They can be upgraded and reconfigured, but only with a sapper's table, and that won't happen until the fourth floor.

beats.headline: Spikes on a door
beats.text: Rabid babies are at both doors of the train car, and Carl asks whether Donut still has the two trap modules. Each is a tiny cube the size of a pair of dice. The spike module pops fifty-centimetre spikes out of a one-metre square every two seconds; friendly NPCs and crawlers won't set it off, but once triggered it spikes forever. Could it go on a door? He places it against the janitor car's door, and it lets him set it vertically and moves with the door. When the alarm goes off, shrieks explode behind the far door and experience notifications roll in from mobs impaled on the door spikes.

relations.note: both came out of the same gold sapper's box
